about: Two real redis scale-to-zero outages about 4.5 minutes apart (2026-10-18 11:46 and 11:52), after the first three repeat-outage fixes. Live, the repeat scored 0.708 (root_cause) against 0.809 for the same outage with no history: the first outage's unready redis pod was still counted as a faint rival, because the symptom's own alert had resolved while other alerts of that incident still fired. Captured through the Chronicle API; the deleted redis pods the live (windowed) graph contained are added to the graph.
